name: peek-mail
description: Let Claude read your Gmail, safely. Read-only by construction — it provably cannot mark, move, delete, or send anything.
long_description:
Peek gives Claude read-only access to your Gmail inbox. Ask Claude to find, summarize, or pull details from your mail right inside a conversation.

The part that matters: Peek is read-only by design, not by promise. It opens your mailbox in IMAP read-only mode and only ever peeks at messages, so it cannot mark anything read, move it, delete it, or send on your behalf. The code has no write path at all — you can read it and confirm.

No servers and no cloud. Your credentials are stored in your operating system's keychain and never leave your machine. Revoke access any time from your Google account.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the mail account configured for this extension.

tools.name: search_mail
tools.description: Search the mailbox with Gmail search syntax and return newest-first headlines with UIDs. Read-only.

tools.name: read_message
tools.description: Read one message (headers and plain-text body) by UID. Read-only — never marks as read.

email.title: Gmail address
email.description: The Gmail address to read, for example you@gmail.com

app_password.title: Gmail app password
app_password.description: A 16-character app password from Google (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Requires 2-Step Verification. Read-only and revocable any time. Spaces are fine.
